author: RIP_Avicus
body:
Hey guys;
So today me and my friend BloB_Gaming were messing around, and we managed to think up a new gamemode:
Every player is against each other,and there are a scattering of monuments over the map. Every player has to control as many of these as possible. The game could also be easier with small teams of 5 people and up to 8 teams.
This could be good because you would have to keep your points as well as attacking other points. I think that a monument system could work, so you would have to break the obsidian, which would claim the monument for your team. The obsidian would then respawn in 30 seconds to avoid the defenders claiming it back instantly.
You could have a points system similar to CTH, where every 30 seconds a countdown would start, and at the end of that, however many monuments your team had would amount to a certain amount of points.
Or, you could have a constant score keeping system, so, say if you had 3 monuments, you would get 3 (or 30) points a second, and the goal would be to get to, say, 350 points.
Opinions would be greatly appreciated. :D
